records.title: DEVELOPMENT OF TIRUPATI AIRPORT AS INTERNATIONAL HUB
details:
To cater international operations at Tirupati Airport, the work for extension of
 existing Runway from 2286m X 45m to 3810m X 45m for operation of Code-E
 type of Aircraft is under progress.
AAI has received requests from M/s BES Space Private Limited and M/s ARCA
 for allotment of land for setting up of FTO in Andhra Pradesh

records.title: MULTI-MODAL LOGISTICS PARK IN VISAKHAPATNAM
details:
The Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the Visakhapatnam Multi-Modal Logistics 
Park (MMLP) was awarded on 23.04.2026 with the completion period of one year. The 
estimated cargo capacity for the proposed MMLP shall be determined as part of DPR 
studies.

records.title: EXTENSION OF RCS SCHEME
details:
(a): The proposal to extend
RCS-UDAN Scheme, launched
on 21.10.2016, is under
consideration of the
Government. (b): The scheme
has succeeded in enhancing
the remote and regional
connectivity by operationalising
86 unserved and underserved
airports (including 13
heliports and 2 water
aerodromes) through 609
Routes (till 25.11.24)
benefiting more than 146 lakh
domestic passengers through
2.86 Lakh RCS flights and
the potential for further
enhancement of affordable
regional connectivity to
unserved airstrips in
the remote corners of the
country, are some of the
factors taken into account for
the above consideration
